name: TC-SL-006 — 店铺视觉状态4种状态正确展示 [P1]
description: 验证4种视觉状态与服务端计算逻辑一致：视觉未启动、冷启、新增、正常运行

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr'); const statuses = []; const expected = ['视觉未启动', '视觉定制中（冷启）', '视觉定制中（新增）', '正常运行']; for (const row of rows) { const cells = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('td')); const statusCell = cells.find(td => expected.some(e => td.textContent.includes(e))); if (statusCell) statuses.push(statusCell.textContent.trim()); } const foundTypes = [...new Set(statuses)]; return { totalRows: rows.length, statuses, foundTypes }; })()
steps.description: 采集所有店铺视觉状态

steps.expression: (() => { const expected = ['视觉未启动', '视觉定制中（冷启）', '视觉定制中（新增）', '正常运行']; const text = document.body.textContent; const found = expected.filter(e => text.includes(e)); return { expected, found, allPresent: found.length === expected.length }; })()
steps.description: 验证4种状态在页面中存在

_testDesign.preconditions: 店铺列表存在覆盖4种视觉状态的店铺
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 访问店铺列表
2. 采集所有店铺的视觉状态列
3. 验证状态值在4种枚举范围内
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 所有店铺视觉状态值在4种枚举范围内
2. 无进行中迭代+无基准包=视觉未启动
3. 有进行中迭代+无基准包=冷启
4. 有进行中迭代+有基准包=新增
5. 无进行中迭代+有基准包=正常运行
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
